discovery_queue_items_lease_check.name: discovery_queue_items_lease_check

backup_entries_verified_check.name: backup_entries_verified_check
backup_entries_verified_check.value: "backup_entries"."status" <> 'verified' or ("backup_entries"."verified_at" is not null and ("backup_entries"."entry_type" <> 'file' or ("backup_entries"."sha256" is not null and "backup_entries"."dest_rel_path" is not null)))
